Accelerate your build

Muse Code is a fast and accessible coding agent powered by Muse models.
←→to navigate
Multi-agent by default
Multiple agents coordinate on every task. Workers in parallel, reviewers in the background, so you ship faster without sacrificing quality.
Fully auditable
Every action is transparent and traceable. Review generated code, understand AI decisions and maintain confidence with built-in visibility across your workflows.
Built for Muse models
Co-trained for tight integration. Better tool use, fewer retries and higher-quality output than a generic wrapper.
